# Updating projects

Generated projects store answers in `.copier-answers.yml`. Pull template improvements with:

```bash
cd my-project
uvx copier update --trust
```

## What update does

1. Re-renders the project from the current template + stored answers
2. Applies a three-way merge against your local changes
3. Re-runs applicable `_tasks` when trusted

## Tips

- Commit before updating so conflicts are recoverable.
- Prefer not to heavily edit protected baseline paths (`packages/platform-kit`, `packages/ui-kit`, CI scaffolding) — those should come from the template/kit.
- If answers are outdated (missing `stack` / `platform_profile`), regenerate from a fresh copy or edit `.copier-answers.yml` carefully before update.
- Example backends in this monorepo may still point at older template paths; see [HANDOFF](./handoff.mdx).

## Regenerating an example in-tree

```bash
# From Aham root — illustrative
uvx copier copy --trust --skip-tasks \
  -d stack=backend \
  -d repo_layout=monorepo \
  -d architecture=monolith \
  -d messaging=none \
  -d platform_profile=saas \
  -d repo_manager=none \
  ./template /tmp/aham-mono
```

Then compare or replace the example folder intentionally (do not blindly overwrite without review).
